name: Design Challenge
goal: The design challenge is the main problem to solve with a project. The mechanics, dynamics, aesthetics, and user stories are based on that challenge. In essence, the design challenge is the base of the project. A good design challenge is necessary for a successful end product.
normalLearnings: Asking feedback (from teacher / client / pedagogy students).
result:
Form of solution: 2D virtual companion, gifting game.
Users: high schoolers around the age 12 to 14 that are on a waiting list to be helped for their loneliness.
Context: a safe environment on a mobile device (e.g., phone).
Perform activity: write personal diary entries, send and receive gifts with a motivational message from and to other players through their companion.
Target performance: make the player feel less alone.
validation: The design challenge is verified with teachers, the pedagogy students and the client.
contribution: Now the design challenge is defined, the group can focus on the MDA of the project and user scenarios. This will result in the ten page game design document.
